metaDescription: Order custom enamel awards recognition for your team. Durable, colorful medals and pins from Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Enamel awards offer a polished, durable finish that stands out in any recognition program. Unlike standard acrylic or resin pieces, enamel allows for vibrant, long-lasting color that won't fade over time. Whether you need custom medals for a safety milestone or lapel pins for employee anniversaries, the hard enamel surface resists scratching and maintains its shine. Perfect for corporate events or annual award ceremonies, these pieces can be decorated with your logo using cloisonné or soft enamel techniques.
heroAltText: Custom enamel awards recognition medals and pins with colorful logos for corporate events
